source_method: Original built-in imagegen backdrop set, with ten layers rebuilt from ten new built-in imagegen paintings; nearest-neighbour crop, discrete palette, depth values and two-axis wrap joins

run_b.atlas_grid: 4x4 grid of 256x256 cells in 1024x1024 RGBA; weather final cell contains two nonoverlapping half-cell sprites; sites use three rows
run_b.json_coordinates: Unity sprite rect y from image bottom; points from individual sprite rect top-left
run_b.brightness: Landmarks, pipes, fires and sites opaque HSV value p90 <= 0.55; sparse cores may be brighter.
run_b.weather_alpha: Banks <=80, wisps <=64, mist/gust <=48, smoke <=56, embers <=72 of 255.
run_b.count_resolution: Landmarks and fires each list 15 names, so forgewell_00 and lavachannel_00 fill the sixteenth cells. Weather lists 17 names; two sprites share its last 256px cell.

run_c.atlas_grid: Each 1024x1024 RGBA atlas has a 4x4 grid of 256x256 cells; JSON y is from image bottom.
run_c.emitter_anchor: Every ground-attached loop anchors at local (128,236) pixels from cell top; place on the corresponding run B emitter point.
run_c.art_method: Built-in image generation painted 2x2 transparent key sheets; inspected keys were palette cleaned with nearest-neighbor sampling and cyclic deformation/blending.
